opening.argument: The material is framed as an educational discussion of online earning and part-time work, and the description expressly limits the information to educational and informational purposes. Although it includes an Upstox free demat account link and demonstrates an Upstox screen displaying a ₹400 referral reward, sharing options, and an earnings control, those visuals show a presented promotion rather than a completed payout or a requirement that viewers participate. The withdrawal screen likewise displays or enters ₹400 without showing that funds were successfully withdrawn. Finally, the unclear statement that “How to make a double in Education Investment Online is a very interesting concept” does not establish a promised return, required payment, or endorsed offer. Taken together, the evidence supports ordinary rewards and informational promotion, without proving deceptive conduct or an outcome.
